items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive/SharePoint web viewer
items.description: We're enabling PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. With this update, users who have the appropriate usage rights can annotate these protected PDFs in place in their browser while preserving the file's sensitivity label, encryption, and usage rights when changes are saved.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
items.description: Get a closer look at shared content in Teams calls and meetings with pinch-to-zoom using your touchpad. Quickly zoom in to make small text and detailed visuals easier to see, then zoom back out for the full view. Existing zoom controls remain available.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Full-screen mode on task grid
items.description:
Task grid full-screen mode enables project managers and team members to expand the task grid to use the available screen space. By minimizing surrounding page elements, users gain a larger workspace for viewing and managing task hierarchies, schedules, assignments, dependencies, and other task details.
Users can enter full-screen mode when they need a focused planning experience and return to the standard project view when they need access to other project information.

items.title: SharePoint: Copilot Search in SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: Copilot Search brings AI-powered, natural-language search to SharePoint and OneDrive, combining relevant results, AI-generated summaries with source references, intuitive filters, and a seamless handoff to Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
items.description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

items.title: Power Apps: Prompt Columns - multiple lines of text output
items.description: Prompt columns can now store multilple lines of text as prompt output, enabling longer and detailed AI-generated insights to be stored in your tables.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Prompt column values in bulk for existing records (backfill)
items.description: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones. Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need, so historical data gets the same AI-generated insights as incoming data, without touching each record one at a time.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
items.description: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes. This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
items.description: Gain proactive visibility into meeting quality across your organization with AI-powered insights in the Teams admin center that identify emerging patterns, highlight impacted users and locations, and surface likely causes with recommended actions. This helps IT administrators detect and address issues earlier, improve meeting quality, and stay ahead of potential disruptions.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
items.description: Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. With standard capabilities, Dataverse Q&A supports questions such as “What is the work history of this asset?” or “Who worked on this job last?” Organizations c

items.title: Excel: Excel canvas
items.description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.154 - Sign in to Edge with a Google account
items.description: Users can now sign in to Microsoft Edge using a Google account in addition to the Microsoft account from the profile menu and Edge sign-in screen. Available for Windows and macOS devices.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the NonMicrosoftAccountSignInEnabled policy.

items.title: Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
items.description: We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
items.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. The new Meeting chats section will replace the Meeting chats filter, that was previously available at t

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
items.description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Watermarking Protection
items.description: Watermarking Protection in Microsoft Edge helps organizations visibly reinforce data protection policies by overlaying a persistent watermark on sensitive content viewed in the browser. This feature is designed to deter unauthorized sharing, support compliance efforts, and increase user awareness when handling confidential information.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
items.description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
items.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
items.description: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - One-Time Evaluation Frequency
items.description:
Quality evaluation plans now support a Once frequency type for both case evaluations and conversation evaluations. When creating an evaluation plan, users can select Once from the Frequency type dropdown to run the evaluation a single time instead of on a recurring schedule or trigger-based cadence.
This option is useful for one-time evaluation runs where ongoing recurrence is not needed. Once selected, the plan is configured to execute only one time based on the specified plan start date.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
items.description:
Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.
Building on the initial launch, planned improvements include:

Improved context handling and support for larger plans.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
items.description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Out of the box real time translation on digital channels
items.description: With this feature, users get an out-of-the-box solution for translation services, so they don't need to bring their own web resources. Service representatives get updated feature usage with more configurations. They can tailor their conversations more accurately based on their existing skills and preferences. The feature is transparent yet modernized with new settings, making conversations easier to consume in a language of the representative's choice.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
items.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
items.description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.
For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshoot

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Organization Evaluation Score for Apps and Agents
items.description: Today, IT admins manually review trust data for Teams apps and agents in the Teams admin center to ensure they meet organizational security, privacy, and compliance standards. This feature introduces a scalable, automated evaluation process. Admins can define their organization’s trust requirements once, and the system will automatically assess each app and agent—generating an evaluation score and detailed evaluation report tailored to those requirements. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Co-organizer updates in Webinars
items.description: Co-organizers can edit webinar details, publish the event, and cancel the event, similar to the organizer.

items.title: Power Pages: Design studio - Enhance OpenID Connect with encrypted token support
items.description:
This feature adds support for token-level encryption during authentication, allowing Power Pages to accept encrypted ID tokens in addition to signed tokens. It ensures secure claim transmission, improves compatibility with advanced identity providers, and strengthens overall authentication security without changing existing sign-in flows.
